title:
A "module" represents a set of compilation units (Java source file, Python/JavaScript script file) of code.
This will be packaged as an artifact in various ways depending on the language being generated:
 - Python: [module](https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/modules.html)
 - Java: [JAR file](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JAR_(file_format))
 - JavaScript: [module](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Guide/Modules)
name: Code.DefinedModule
